verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette stars Taylor Frankie Paul.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Taylor Frankie Paul’s season of The Bachelorette'; R2: 'starring “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” alum Taylor Frankie Paul'; R3: 'Taylor Frankie Paul’s season of “The Bachelorette”'; R4: 'Led by reality star Taylor Frankie Paul, Season 22'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm Taylor Frankie Paul as the star of Season 22.

verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette is not currently airing on ABC.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'ABC officially decided not to air Taylor Frankie Paul’s episodes'; R2: 'ABC TV has pulled the pending season 22'; R3: 'ABC has decided not to move forward with airing'; R4: 'ABC decided to pull the new season'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state the season was pulled and is not airing on ABC as scheduled.

verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette is not currently streaming on Hulu.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The new season was set to begin airing on March 22, with episodes streaming the next day on Hulu' but pulled; no references indicate it is streaming; R1/R3/R4 confirm not moving forward/airing
verifications.reasoning: Season was pulled before airing, so episodes are not streaming on Hulu; directly supported by context of pullback.

verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette experienced production delays.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: References discuss pulling/a not airing after production (e.g., R4 mentions production costs), but no mention of production delays for Season 22; SLOMW S5 production halted instead.

verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette was pulled from the schedule.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'pull The Bachelorette Season 22 from the network’s lineup'; R2: 'ABC TV has pulled the pending season'; R3: 'ABC’s decision to pull the new season'; R4: 'ABC decided to pull'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state the season was pulled from the schedule.

verifications.claim: American Idol reruns are replacing Season 22 of The Bachelorette on ABC.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'In its place, the network is airing an American Idol rerun'; R3: 'ABC will broadcast a rerun of “American Idol” Season 24, Episode 8 in its place'; R4: 'ABC will air a rerun of “American Idol” Season 24, Episode 8'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references explicitly confirm American Idol rerun replacing it.

verifications.claim: Decider and Media Play News reported that Season 22 of The Bachelorette is officially delayed/paused "at this time."
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1 (Decider): 'not move forward with the new season of The Bachelorette at this time'; R2 (Media Play News): 'not move forward with the new season of ‘The Bachelorette’ at this time'
verifications.reasoning: R1 (Decider) and R2 (Media Play News) directly quote the 'at this time' statement indicating delay/pause.

verifications.claim: Syracuse.com and Hulu reported that older seasons and related specials (like "Before the First Rose") can still be streamed on Hulu.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3 (Syracuse.com): 'Previous seasons of “The Bachelorette” are streaming on Hulu'; 'Paul’s “Before the First Rose” special ... remains streaming on both Hulu'; R4 (Syracuse.com): 'Taylor’s “Before the First Rose” special is still available to stream on Hulu' — no mention of Hulu reporting this
verifications.reasoning: Syracuse.com (R3/R4) reports older seasons/specials stream on Hulu, but no evidence Hulu itself reported it; claim incorrectly attributes reporting to Hulu.

verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette is not currently listed to premiere on the Facebook page of The Bachelorette.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No references mention or check The Bachelorette's Facebook page.
